name: Build New Website
description: End-to-end workflow for building a new website from requirements to deployment.

steps.task: Analyze the project brief. Break requirements into tasks for design, frontend, backend, testing, and deployment. Create a project plan with milestones and assign tasks to team members.
Create the design system: color palette, typography, spacing scale, component specs, and page layouts. Output Tailwind config and component wireframes.
Set up the project scaffold, database schema, API endpoints, authentication, and any third-party integrations specified in the requirements.
Build all pages and components following the design system. Integrate with backend APIs. Ensure responsive design and accessibility.
Write and run test suites (unit, integration, E2E). Test all user flows, edge cases, responsive behavior, and cross-browser compatibility. File bugs and verify fixes.
Set up CI/CD pipeline, Docker configuration, production deployment, SSL, monitoring, and health checks. Deploy to production.
Final review: verify all requirements are met, all tests pass, deployment is stable. Compile delivery report.
